description: Defines the LeaveRequest entity class representing a leave request in the OrangeHRM system, including properties for leave type, date applied, employee, and associated leaves, with ORM mapping annotations.

classes.name: LeaveRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing a leave request with ORM mappings, properties for leave type, application date, employee, and associated leaves, along with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier (ID) of the leave request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Retrieves the leave type associated with the request.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Assigns a leave type to the request.

methods.name: getDateApplied
methods.description: Gets the date when the leave was applied for.

methods.name: setDateApplied
methods.description: Sets the date when the leave was applied.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the employee associated with the leave request.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the collection of leaves linked to this request.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets the collection of leaves for this request.
